messages:
Avery Brooks: Announcing a small preview of 'Secure Snapshot Escrow' for Private/VPC customers. Purpose: let customers escrow immutable snapshots to a customer-controlled escrow location with audit proofs for compliance audits.

Nora Li (Product): Quick summary: customers can opt into escrow, provide an escrow endpoint + KMS configuration, and each snapshot generates a signed proof token (snapshot id, hash, timestamp). We also offer a dry-run mode to validate configs.

Ravi Patel (Security): Security notes: escrowed snapshots are encrypted with customer KMS keys. Proof tokens are signed with customer HSM or our short-lived attestation key if HSM not available. Retention options: 30/180/365 days. Design doc: internal link.

Priya Kapoor (Legal): For external comms avoid phrasing like "we hold your backups". Use: "customers may escrow snapshots to a customer-designated location; Redwood provides verifiable attestations for audit purposes." Also need the dataflow diagram before public KB.

Avery Brooks: Migration: opt-in per-tenant, no agent restart. First escrow handshake may take ~45s for large snapshots. Rollback is a console toggle and we keep a 7-day deprecation log when toggled off.

Nora Li (Product): Pilot cohort = 6 customers. We'll schedule a technical onboarding and a compliance walkthrough. Please DM me pilot suggestions.

Ops Bot: deploy: escrow-preview v0.1 -> staging :white_check_mark: (2m 20s)

Ravi Patel (Security): Action items: security to publish attest token spec; eng infra to validate escrow endpoint in staging; legal to sign off on wording and diagrams.

Priya Kapoor (Legal): I'll post suggested customer copy and a short FAQ draft to the runbook.

Avery Brooks: Thanks team. Add any blockers to the runbook and ping me directly. We'll hold a walkthrough Thursday 11:00 PT. :lock:
